events.catalyst_description: BorgWarner reiterated its prior guidance that turbine generator production will begin in Hendersonville, North Carolina in 2027, with an initial 2 GW of installed capacity, and that turbine generator sales are expected to exceed $300 million in the first year of production.

entities.evidence_span:
In response to questions it has received, BorgWarner Inc.
(the “Company”) reiterates its prior statements that the Company continues to expect turbine generator production to begin
in Hendersonville, North Carolina in 2027, with an initial 2 GW of installed capacity.
